title: Glowing hole in bedroom wall and electrical failure

tellings.quote: there's about a 4 and 1 half or 5T hole diameter in a north wall of my bedroom

plain: Mario Woods, described as a former guard at a nuclear site, says that on December 17, 2017, at his home in Georgia, a glowing hole about four and a half to five feet across appeared in the north wall of his bedroom, and the electricity failed. He mentions a person named Jake in the account. He tells it as part of what he describes as an abduction experience.
